name: Nome Tatsuhiro
source:
The oldest in the group. Although he can be blunt and unfriendly, he acts like an older brother and takes good care of the other members. He shows a passionate side to himself at concerts, but usually he is a mediator who approaches everything calmly.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/#nometatsuhiro]official website[/url]]
